description: This PHP script handles deletion of test case scripts in the TestLink project, including initializing environment, managing code tracker integration, executing deletion queries, and checking user permissions.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and objects for the script, including parsing request parameters and setting up code tracker info.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves code tracker configuration and interface object if enabled for the project.

methods.name: del_testcase_script
methods.description: Deletes a test case script link from the database based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to modify test cases.
